_why: Where things live in this repo, as DATA (A51-1, user 2026-10-27: the root kept filling up with working copies and one-off scripts). tools/layout.py (RepoLayout) reads it; docs/LAYOUT.md is generated from it (python tools/layout.py build); check_root_tidy fails on a root entry not listed here. Add a folder = add one line here.

staging._why: Every working copy promote.py --init makes lives INSIDE home, e.g. .staging/main. The prefix still marks a working copy anywhere (old .staging-xxx trees keep working), so skip rules and root detection match by prefix.

books._why: Paths from the real root. The two lasting files live in the home; the three LOCKS stay at the root on purpose: they exist only while held, and agents, old branches and docs/COORDINATION.md take the coordination lock by that exact path - moving it would let two writers in at once.

out._why: Everything a tool or a test writes for one PC goes under here. Git-ignored; deleting it loses nothing that is in git.

kinds.test_media: photos and videos for face/video tests (was _photo_test/, _video_test/)
kinds.runs: results of long experiments (RL, benchmarks) a tool saves
kinds.ai_watch: the AI usage-limit watcher's state, events and worker logs (tools/ai_watch.py)

pc._why: The PC folder around the repo (A51-3, user 2026-10-27/28): rename the repo folder and tidy the parent. tools/tidy_pc.py reads this; it only MOVES, never deletes, and does an entry only when its ok names who approved it. Folder access, the hub and the friend's apps keep working: config/partners.json uses {parent}/..., and the friend's repos stay git repos wherever they sit. Add a move = add one entry; approve = fill ok.

moves.why: the friend's git repo (ChocolateOwO/Photobooth); a moved repo still pulls
run data of the booth, kept beside the repo, never inside it

ตู้มหัสจรรย์_*.pdf

files.README.md: what this project is, how to start
files.HANDOFF.md: first file any AI reads: rules, where things are, how to hand off
files.CLAUDE.md: Claude's short rules (read on every turn)
files.promote.py: staging -> real tree, only when QC is green
files.MiceHub.spec: the ONE way to build MiceHub.exe
files.PATCHES.md: index of the numbered code patches (tools/save_code_patch.py)
files.promt.md: the user's prompt log, written by the .claude hook

dirs.main_python: the hub (MiceHub): server, device routes, web pages
dirs.nong: Nong Studio (nong/main_python_set_nong): moves, sequences, simulator UI
dirs.apps: apps the hub serves: voice, faces, gacha, camera, photobooth, tv
dirs.config: settings and registries (JSON), one file per subject
dirs.tools: developer tools: plan, handoff, build, bench, layout
dirs.handoff: one task file per open task (handoff/tasks/)
dirs.llm: the voice helper's local model data
dirs.dist: the built MiceHub.exe and its shortcuts
dirs..staging: working copies (git-ignored), one folder per task
dirs._out: what tools and tests write on this PC (git-ignored)
dirs..claude: Claude Code project settings and agents

tolerated._why: Git-ignored things tools still make at the root. Reported, never a failure: they are on one PC only. The PC steps move them into _out/ or .staging/.
